cases.sql: SELECT version()

CREATE TYPE cj_pair AS(n numeric,label text); CREATE TYPE cj_other AS(x numeric,y text); CREATE TYPE cj_xid AS(n xid); CREATE TYPE cj_json AS(n integer,j json); CREATE TYPE cj_enum AS ENUM ('a','b'); CREATE TYPE cj_enums AS(e cj_enum); CREATE TYPE cj_physical AS(a text,b integer)

CREATE TABLE cj_left(id integer,v cj_pair); CREATE TABLE cj_right(id integer,v cj_other); INSERT INTO cj_left VALUES (1,ROW(1.0,'a')),(2,ROW(1.00,'a')),(3,ROW(2,'b')),(4,ROW(NULL,NULL)),(5,NULL); INSERT INTO cj_right VALUES (1,ROW(1.000,'a')),(2,ROW(2,'b')),(3,ROW(NULL,NULL)),(4,NULL)
SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM cj_left a JOIN cj_right b ON a.v=b.v ORDER BY l NULLS LAST,r NULLS LAST
SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM cj_left a LEFT JOIN cj_right b ON a.v=b.v ORDER BY l NULLS LAST,r NULLS LAST
SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM cj_left a RIGHT JOIN cj_right b ON a.v=b.v ORDER BY l NULLS LAST,r NULLS LAST
SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM cj_left a FULL JOIN cj_right b ON a.v=b.v ORDER BY l NULLS LAST,r NULLS LAST
SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM cj_left a FULL JOIN cj_right b ON a.v=b.v AND a.id>b.id ORDER BY l NULLS LAST,r NULLS LAST
SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM (VALUES(1,1),(2,NULL)) a(id,n) JOIN (VALUES(1,1),(2,NULL)) b(id,n) ON ROW(a.n)=ROW(b.n) ORDER BY l,r
SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM (VALUES(1,ROW(1)),(2,ROW(NULL::integer))) a(id,v) JOIN (VALUES(1,ROW(1)),(2,ROW(NULL::integer))) b(id,v) ON a.v=b.v ORDER BY l,r
SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES(ROW(1))) a(v) JOIN (VALUES(ROW(1,2))) b(v) ON a.v=b.v
SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES(ROW(1))) a(v) JOIN (VALUES(ROW(2,2))) b(v) ON a.v=b.v
SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES(ROW(1,2))) a(v) JOIN (VALUES(ROW(1,2::bigint))) b(v) ON a.v=b.v
SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES(ROW(1,2))) a(v) JOIN (VALUES(ROW(2,2::bigint))) b(v) ON a.v=b.v
CREATE TABLE cj_xids(id integer,v cj_xid); INSERT INTO cj_xids VALUES(1,ROW('1'::xid)),(2,ROW('1'::xid)),(3,ROW('2'::xid)),(4,NULL)
SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM cj_xids a JOIN cj_xids b ON a.v=b.v ORDER BY l,r

CREATE TABLE cj_json_left(id integer,v cj_json); CREATE TABLE cj_json_right(id integer,v cj_json); INSERT INTO cj_json_left VALUES(1,ROW(1,'{}'::json)); INSERT INTO cj_json_right VALUES(1,ROW(2,'{}'::json))
SELECT count(*) FROM cj_json_left a JOIN cj_json_right b ON a.v=b.v
SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM cj_json_left a FULL JOIN cj_json_right b ON a.v=b.v ORDER BY l NULLS LAST,r NULLS LAST
UPDATE cj_json_right SET v=ROW(1,'[]'::json)
SELECT count(*) FROM cj_json_left a JOIN cj_json_right b ON a.v=b.v
UPDATE cj_json_right SET v=ROW(1,'{}'::json)
SELECT count(*) FROM cj_json_left a JOIN cj_json_right b ON a.v=b.v
INSERT INTO cj_json_right VALUES(2,ROW(1,'{}'::json))
SELECT count(*) FROM cj_json_left a JOIN cj_json_right b ON a.v=b.v
UPDATE cj_json_left SET v=ROW(1,NULL); UPDATE cj_json_right SET v=ROW(1,NULL)
SELECT count(*) FROM cj_json_left a JOIN cj_json_right b ON a.v=b.v
DELETE FROM cj_json_right; SELECT count(*) FROM cj_json_left a JOIN cj_json_right b ON a.v=b.v

CREATE TABLE cj_enum_values(id integer,v cj_enums); INSERT INTO cj_enum_values VALUES(1,ROW('a'::cj_enum)),(2,ROW('a'::cj_enum)),(3,ROW('b'::cj_enum)); PREPARE cj_enum_join(cj_enums) AS SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM cj_enum_values a JOIN (SELECT 1 AS id,$1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2,ROW('a'::cj_enum)::cj_enums) b ON a.v=b.v ORDER BY l,r
EXECUTE cj_enum_join(ROW('a'::cj_enum)::cj_enums)
ALTER TYPE cj_enum RENAME VALUE 'a' TO 'renamed'
EXECUTE cj_enum_join(ROW('renamed'::cj_enum)::cj_enums)

PREPARE cj_physical_join(cj_physical) AS SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM (VALUES(1,'(hello,8)'::cj_physical),(2,'(other,9)'::cj_physical)) a(id,v) JOIN (SELECT 1 AS id,$1 AS v) b ON a.v=b.v ORDER BY l,r; ALTER TYPE cj_physical ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE bytea
EXECUTE cj_physical_join(ROW(decode('68656c6c6f','hex'),8)::cj_physical)
SET work_mem='64kB'
SELECT count(*) FROM generate_series(1,200) a(i) JOIN generate_series(1,200) b(i) ON ROW(a.i::numeric,repeat('x',1024))::cj_pair=ROW(b.i::numeric,repeat('x',1024))::cj_other
SELECT count(*) FROM generate_series(1,200) a(i) JOIN generate_series(1,200) b(i) ON ROW((a.i::text)::xid)::cj_xid=ROW((b.i::text)::xid)::cj_xid
RESET work_mem
SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM cj_left a FULL JOIN cj_right b ON a.v=b.v ORDER BY l NULLS LAST,r NULLS LAST
SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM cj_xids a JOIN cj_xids b ON a.v=b.v ORDER BY l,r
SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM cj_enum_values a JOIN (VALUES(1,ROW('renamed'::cj_enum)::cj_enums)) b(id,v) ON a.v=b.v ORDER BY l,r
